decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch with its own webpage and strong fit to the firm's established geospatial integration business, management would likely continue it because visible commitment and sunk development effort outweigh any early uncertainty.

The building data digital twin service supports the firm's announced direction toward broader enterprise-integrated geospatial solutions, so management would likely persist and treat any weak initial traction as temporary.

Because this authentication and identity delegation service is close to the existing offer and likely reuses internal capabilities, management would be inclined to keep it as a complementary module rather than admit a premature setback after a recent launch.

An open GIS application development framework is strategically central for a medium-sized German geospatial software firm with its own R&D, making continued support likely despite limited early market evidence.

The firm publicly announced this new identity service and it closely complements GIS integration work, so escalation of commitment makes continued market presence more likely than withdrawal after only one year.
